text:
Ravi: Quick FYI - new int8 candidate (q8-lite-1) from the onboarding run shows consistent rerank degradation on our short instruction prompt slice. Delta ~3.8% rerank@1 vs baseline.
Lin: Which prompt slice exactly? small-instruct or multi-turn?
Ravi: small-instruct primarily. Ran local eval: ./eval_harness --model q8-lite-1 --prompts promptsets/small_instruct_mar2026.json --metrics rerank@1,bertscore --out /tmp/q8lite_eval.json
Asha: Any obvious tokenizer/truncation errors in the failing tail?
Ravi: I spot-checked 15 failures; answers are shorter / less specific, not truncated. Example: asked for config path; baseline returns exact filename, q8-lite-1 gives generic "check config file".
Lin: Before we queue humans, run near-dupe and fingerprint to rule out duplicate-induced noise. Last week dedupe merged lots of paraphrases.
Ravi: Running now: python tools/dupe_scan.py --input /tmp/q8lite_eval.json --thresh 0.9. Will post results.
(20m later)
Ravi: dupe report: 5 exact duplicates, 7 high-similarity (>0.92), rest unique -> ~0.5% exact, 0.9% high-sim. Not enough to explain patterned semantic weakening.
Asha: OK queue micro-golden for the worst 100 diffs. @label-bot create-batch --name "q8lite-rerank-100" --size 100 --golden true --owners Lin,Asha --priority high
label-bot: Batch q8lite-rerank-100 created. ETA 10-12h. Add :eyes: to allow auto-approve by seniors.
Lin: Also kick a quant-sensitivity sweep toggling kv_cache, prefilling, and kernel_precision. Could be numeric instability interacting with streaming kernels.
Ravi: Launched ./quant_sweep --model q8-lite-1 --vars kv_cache,prefill,kernel_precision --range on,off;0,32;fast,precise. Job id qs-1423.
ops-bot: Canary route created: canary/q8lite-0.5pct on route small-instruct. Deploy job 90021. Logs & telemetry retention 72h.
Asha: Label plan: blind pair senior relabel + adversarial paraphrase step. If micro-golden pass-rate < 0.98 or entailment delta > 0.03 we hold rollout. Decision owners: Lin + Ravi.
Lin: Tag promptset examples with metadata tag: ["q8lite-investigate","rerank-worst100"], snapshot id snap-1771009999.
Ravi: I'll post a short summary to #eng-all if we need infra help. Monitoring quant-sweep + label-bot. :eyes:
Asha: Thanks. If label-bot returns high disagreement we'll escalate to adjudication and run a small rescoring with higher-precision kernels for comparison.
Lin: Good. Keep an eye on canary latency and token-cost; abort if token-cost > baseline*1.15.
Ravi: Will do.
